info.name: CIRS Lab6 — Authenticated full workflow
info.description: Run ONLY against a newly reset, isolated fictional demonstration database. The collection creates reports, categories and an account, changes lifecycle state and deactivates its temporary account. Defaults assume the fictional seeded accounts and CampusDemo2026!; set demoPassword to CIRS_DEMO_PASSWORD when overridden. Tokens remain collection variables and expire after 30 minutes. No production service or real account data should be used. This is a Newman-compatible collection; CLI executions are not Postman Desktop screenshots.

item.name: 08 Campus account cannot list all incidents
09 Campus account cannot read another report

exec: pm.test('Other user has no fixture reports', () => pm.expect(b).to.eql([]));

pm.test('Server defaults and actor', () => { pm.expect(b.reporterId).to.eql(100); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('REPORTED'); pm.expect(b.priority).to.eql('MEDIUM'); pm.expect(b.history[0].actorId).to.eql(100); });
pm.test('Update and audit', () => { pm.expect(b.title).to.eql('Updated fictional Postman report'); pm.expect(b.history[b.history.length-1].action).to.eql('UPDATED'); });

pm.test('Only public comment returned', () => { pm.expect(b).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.every(x => x.isInternal === false)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b)).not.to.include('Private training-only indicator'); });
pm.test('Both comments visible to IT', () => pm.expect(b).to.have.lengthOf(2));

item.name: 22 Campus user cannot post internal note
33 Public history never contains internal-note text

exec: pm.test('Lifecycle audit and safe history', () => { const actions=b.map(x=>x.action); pm.expect(actions).to.include('CREATED'); pm.expect(actions).to.include('PRIORITY_CHANGED'); pm.expect(b.filter(x=>x.action==='STATUS_CHANGED').map(x=>x.newValue)).to.eql(['ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED']); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b)).not.to.include('Private training-only indicator'); });

item.name: 41 Inactive category cannot be used for a new report

exec: pm.test('No account secrets in list', () => { pm.expect(b).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.every(x=>!('password_hash' in x)&&!('password' in x))).to.eql(true); });
